tools.name: comparar_precios
tools.description: Use this when the user has already chosen a product (or a few) and wants to know where to buy it or to compare its price across shops: for example after you recommended a model. Pass each product as brand + model, the way it is sold (e.g. 'Cecotec Conga 3790', 'Bosch GSB 18V-55'), or its EAN/GTIN ba

tools.name: buscar_productos
tools.description: Search products sold by Spanish online shops indexed by SeeStocks (es.seestocks.com) and get their current selling prices. Write `consulta` in Spanish, the way a shopper would (e.g. 'taladro percutor bateria', 'zapatillas running mujer 38'); an EAN barcode or a shop SKU also works. Use `marca` or `t

tools.name: ficha_producto
tools.description: Get every shop that sells a product, with price, shipping cost and total, sorted from cheapest. `id` comes from buscar_productos. Prices are in euros. `envio_eur` null means the shop does not publish the shipping cost (not free); `precio_total_eur` is then null too. `bajada` is a real price drop rec

tools.name: ofertas_marca
tools.description: Get the recent price drops and discounted products of a brand, plus its price statistics. Use it when the user asks about deals, sales or prices of a brand in general (not of one product). `marca` is the brand name or slug (e.g. 'Bosch', 'bestway'). `bajadas` are real price drops recorded by SeeStoc

tools.name: explorar_categoria
tools.description: Get an overview of a type of product in Spanish online shops: how many products and shops SeeStocks tracks, the price range (minimum, 10th percentile, median, 90th percentile, maximum), the cheapest products, the products sold by most shops and the biggest real price drops of the last 30 days. Use i

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ficha_producto · Public sink: ficha_producto · Destructive: buscar_productos, ficha_producto.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ficha_producto · Public sink: ficha_producto · Destructive: buscar_productos, ficha_producto

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
